verdicts.reason: A breaks the stripe motif. The grey, blue and red bands have odd white gaps between them and all stop at about y=675, leaving a dead white strip along the bottom. The white card drops off that same edge, so 'TRAVEL MUGS' is jammed against the cut-off with no bottom padding, and the card is crammed against the right side. B keeps the original intact and readable, but it simply pastes the portrait layout onto the square canvas without rearranging anything. The stripes stop short, leaving a white column on the right and lopsided white space on the left, so nothing has been adapted to the new format.
